svg.aria-label: A request arrives with a 100 ms deadline. The budget is a single bar that every hop spends against the same clock: a little to inbound network, a slice to the service plus its PostgreSQL query whose statement_timeout is set from the time remaining, a slice to the outbound gRPC call which carries the same absolute deadline, and the rest is slack before the response returns. The rule beneath it: before any downstream call, if the remaining budget is at or below zero the service throws DEADLINE_EXCEEDED and fails fast instead of starting work that cannot finish in time.

text.style: font: 700 16px -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a;

svg.text: Deadline budget propagation — one clock, every hop

text.style: font: italic 400 11px -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; fill: #555555;

svg.text: inbound deadline = 100 ms · every downstream call budgets against the same clock

svg.text: Fail fast when the budget is gone

text.style: font: italic 400 11px -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; fill: #555555;

svg.text: A slow dependency must not outlive the client's patience.

text.style: font: 400 11px ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace; fill: #1a1a1a;

svg.text: auto left = deadline - now(); if (left <= 0ms) throw grpc::Status{DEADLINE_EXCEEDED};

text.style: font: italic 700 11px -apple-system, system-ui, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; fill: #c0392b;

svg.text: Never start a downstream call you can't finish in time.
